works.title: Vierflügeltango (Tango for four grand pianos)
works.publicNote: Tango for four grand pianos attributed to Bronisław Kaper and associated with the First Piano Quartet (Kaper–Mittmann–Zakin–Pomeranz). The work is documented by a review in the Rhein- und Ruhr-Zeitung, 10 December 1929 (SRC0521). No extant manuscript or printed edition has been verified; the year is approximate and documented by the 1929 review.

timelineEvents.title: ERKLA-Quartett concert review in Hamborn
timelineEvents.label: 10 Dec 1929 · ERKLA in Hamborn
timelineEvents.shortDescription: A Rhein- und Ruhrzeitung review documents Kaper’s appearance with the ERKLA four-piano ensemble in Hamborn, alongside Giuliano Pomeranz, then performing as Julian Pomeranc, Aleksander Zakin, and Leopold Mittmann.
timelineEvents.longDescription: Dr. Funk’s review “Jazz auf vier Flügeln” in the Rhein- und Ruhrzeitung, 10 December 1929, p. 12, documents an ERKLA concert in Hamborn. It names Kaper alongside Giuliano Pomeranz, then performing as Julian Pomeranc, Aleksander Zakin, and Leopold Mittmann.
